acceptanceCriteria: A test with a registry key read only inside a template substitution either selects the setup or fails closed to ALL.
If confirmed, the fix is traced to a TSA-V0 requirement.
body: Suspected, inferred and not tested. Residual from V1-1698 (PR #1096). The new shared-constant path in internal/contextindex/setup_shared.go re-lexes template ${} substitutions, but the registry-key path (registryCallSites, setup_select.go/registry_dialect.go) does not appear to, so a registry key read only inside `${REGISTRY.key}` may be missed while the result still reports selected (fail-open).
title: SUSPECTED: setup-select registry-key path misses key reads inside template ${} substitutions
